# fct_surveys_new_joiners

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_surveys_new_joiners` · dbt area: `surveys`

Responses from the New Joiner Survey sent to advisors early in their Fora journey. Includes CSAT, likelihood to recommend, training engagement, booking status, and qualitative responses. Each row is one response from an advisor. Sourced from Intercom.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `new_joiners_response_id` | Primary key. The survey's response ID (survey receipt ID). >> SOURCE - Intercom |
| `advisor_id` | The 'User ID' in the Portal database. >> SOURCE - Intercom |
| `anything_been_unexpected` | Advisor's answer to 'Has anything about your experience at Fora so far been unexpected? If so, please tell us below.' >> SOURCE - Intercom |
| `barriers_to_client_acquisition` | Advisor's answer to 'What barriers have prevented you from booking a client so far?' >> SOURCE - Intercom |
| `confidence_in_acquiring_clients` | Advisor's answer to 'How confident do you feel offering your services and taking on clients?' on a scale of 1-5. >> SOURCE - Intercom |
| `csat_rating` | Advisor's answer to 'How satisfied are you with your experience at Fora so far?' on a scale of 1-5. >> SOURCE - Intercom |
| `days_signed_up_to_responded` | Calendar days from the Advisor's 'Signed Up Date' to their response's 'Submitted At Date'. >> SOURCE - Intercom / Portal |
| `essentials_helpful_rating` | Advisor's answer to 'How helpful did you find Essentials Training?' on a scale of 1-5. >> SOURCE - Intercom |
| `fora_committment_time` | Advisor's answer to 'Approximately how much time do you spend each week on Fora-related work?' >> SOURCE - Intercom |
| `fora_tools_used` | Advisor's answer to 'Which tools and resources have you engaged with so far?' >> SOURCE - Intercom |
| `has_made_a_booking` | Advisor's answer to 'Have you made a booking yet?' (true/false). >> SOURCE - Intercom |
| `likelihood_to_recommend_rating` | Advisor's answer to 'How likely are you to recommend Fora to someone interested in becoming a travel advisor?' on a scale of 0-10. >> SOURCE - Intercom |
| `live_virtual_training_time_preferences` | Advisor's answer to 'What time of day do you prefer attending live virtual training? (All time options below are in Eastern Standard Time)' >> SOURCE - Intercom |
| `live_virtual_trainings_attended` | Advisor's answer to 'How many Live Virtual Training sessions have you attended (available on the Events calendar in the Portal)?' >> SOURCE - Intercom |
| `live_virtual_trainings_most_helpful` | Advisor's answer to 'Which Live Virtual Training did you find most helpful?' >> SOURCE - Intercom |
| `personal_goals` | Advisor's answer to 'Do you have any personal goals you're hoping to achieve with Fora?' >> SOURCE - Intercom |
| `submitted_at` | Timestamp when the survey was submitted. >> SOURCE - Intercom |
